name: Amazon Selling Partner
description: Amazon's REST-based API enabling selling partners and vendors to programmatically access data on orders, shipments, inventory, listings, and payments.
primary_blocker: Requires Amazon developer account registration and approval, along with specific role configurations.

evidence.claim: The Selling Partner API (SP-API) is a REST-based API that helps Amazon selling partners programmatically access their data on orders, shipments, payments, and much more.
To implement OAuth authorization you must configure your website to accept and process parameters that Amazon passes.
A role is the mechanism used by Selling Partner APIs to determine whether a developer or application has access to an operation or resource.

notes: Amazon SP-API requires setting up an OAuth authorization workflow (LWA token exchange) and obtaining specific roles to access different resources.
